pattern.name: Modular Monolith
pattern.rationale: Selected Modular Monolith (retrieval 0.11, 2 signals, one team, transactional workflow). Trade-offs: simplest to build, test and operate; one deploy pipeline. Weaker independent scaling and fault isolation; modules must be policed to avoid a big ball of mud. Can later be split along module boundaries (strangler).
alternatives_considered: Search-Centric (Index + Retrieval) (score 0.28; retrieval 0.14, 2 signals, no search requirements)

data_flows.description: read/write domain state and audit entries

nfr_mapping.mechanism: Redis cache for hot reads, stateless services with horizontal autoscaling on latency, load test at 2x target load before launch
Multi-AZ deployment with health checks and rolling deploys; retries with backoff and dead-letter handling for asynchronous work; SLO burn-rate alerts

Corporate SSO (OIDC) and OAuth2 for external users, RBAC enforced in the service layer, KMS encryption at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit, secrets in Secrets Manager, card data tokenised via the payments vault
